messages:
Samir (CS Ops): Heads-up — planning to flip on the new onboarding playbook automation for accounts stuck in `stage:setup` >48h. Need final check on CRM filter rules + GDPR/contact dedupe before go-live.
Jenna (CS Lead): thanks. can we exclude 'pilot-' and 'trial-test' accounts from the run? those screw up onboarding metrics.
Luis (RevOps): +1 exclude test prefixes. also we should ensure 'last_contacted' null vs 1970 bugs arent pulled.
Ava (Success Manager): also want to make sure enterprise accounts (tier = "gold"|"platinum") are tagged for human touch — don't want auto emails hitting them.
Samir (CS Ops): agreed re: enterprise. proposed: playbook scope = stage:setup, created >48h, not test prefixes, not gdpr_opt_out, not enterprise_tier. dry-run Wed 11am PT.
Connor (Data Eng): I can run the dry-run query and produce a CSV sample. quick SQL snippet I used for the preview:
```
SELECT id, account_name, tier, created_at, gdpr_opt_out
FROM accounts
WHERE stage = 'setup'
  AND created_at < now() - interval '48 hours'
  AND account_name NOT ILIKE 'pilot-%'
  AND account_name NOT ILIKE 'trial-test%'
  AND gdpr_opt_out = false;
```
Jenna (CS Lead): perfect. can we also add a dedupe pass before send? last quarter we hit duplicates on 3% of the run.
Luis (RevOps): I'll schedule a dedupe job after the preview. simple de-dupe rule: primary by email, choose most recent contact, drop exact duplicates. I can share the job id after kickoff.
OnboardingBot: playbook_preview created (pb_preview_9832) — 342 matched rows, sample stored in S3: s3://redwood-cs/previews/pb_preview_9832.csv :robot_face:
Ava (Success Manager): looked at sample — ~12 test accounts snuck through (prefix mismatch). I'll flag patterns in the sample and send back.
Samir (CS Ops): thanks Ava. action items: Connor runs final preview Mon 10am, Luis runs dedupe job Tue 2pm, Jenna confirms exclusion list, Samir will flip automation on Wed 11am if all green.
Jenna (CS Lead): noted. tagging @Luis @Connor for scheduling. :calendar:
Luis (RevOps): scheduled dedupe job (job_7742) for Tue 14:00 PT. will post job logs here when done.
Connor (Data Eng): preview run queued for Mon 10:00 PT. I'll share sample link and checksum once complete.
OnboardingBot: playbook_scheduled (pb_9832) — dry-run time set 2024-05-06T18:00:00Z — notifications to: Samir, Jenna, Luis, Ava.
Samir (CS Ops): closing loop — if dry-run shows <1% duplicates and no GDPR issues, we proceed. callout: update playbook doc with rollback step and manual hold toggle.
Ava (Success Manager): will add rollback SOP to the playbook doc and include a blameless checklist for manual hold.
Jenna (CS Lead): thanks team. we'll reconvene after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
